description: This file contains a JUnit test class `GenericMapTest` for testing a custom generic map implementation `GenericMap`. It includes a nested subclass `TestGenericMap` that extends `GenericMap` and overrides core methods such as `clearInternal`, `containsKey`, `get`, `isEmpty`, `iterator`, `put`, `putAllIterator`, `removeInternal`, and `size`. The test method `testFoo` performs various map operations and logs their effects, verifying the map's behavior.
